name: drum-notation-importer
description: Transcribe clean printed drum scores into validated Obsidian Drum Notation.

interface.longDescription: Turn clean printed drum-notation images or visible PDF pages into validated Obsidian Drum Notation blocks. The plugin asks before guessing material ambiguities, preserves supported two-pass section repeats, and includes an import report for human review. It does not transcribe audio or handwritten scores, upload files, call external services, or write to an Obsidian vault.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe this printed drum score into validated Obsidian Drum Notation and include the import report.
Convert this drum groove image into an Obsidian-ready drums block and ask about any unclear symbols.
Read this printed song chart, preserve supported section repeats, and split it only when required.
